name: rivalpool48
note: Forty-eight towns, three prices, parting ON only - the _novsep control was already validated at twelve towns (both trees returned byte-identical novsep columns, 767/647/661, proving the float-aim fix reaches this arm ONLY through the parting). Run against the green tree and the float-aim tree and compare the paired per-town cheap-mid difference: twelve towns gave -2.1 +/- 1.5 (t ~ -1.4, decides nothing), forty-eight puts SE under 0.75. The question is whether the fix genuinely thins the cheap end or merely re-rolls the pool.
